snippet.title: GO DUB YOURSELF! - Official Trailer | Movie Dubbing Party Game
snippet.description:
Sign up for the playtest NOW and Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5232060/GO_DUB_YOURSELF/

Dubbing is more fun with friends!

Grab a mic and dub over your favourite clips with your friends. Turn any video into a clip pack, share it on the workshop, then battle it out on the couch or online for up to 12 players. Auto score or judge each other, the choice is yours!

GO DUB YOURSELF! is a party game where you and your friends take your favourite clips, select your lines and when the marker hits the line, you're on! Play it straight, go off-script, or just go crazy. You play your way, auto score, chat vote or even judging each other.

MAKE ANYTHING DUBBABLE
Drop in any video, any clip, any scene. In only a few clicks you can go from your favourite video into a fully dubbable pack in seconds to minutes: mark the lines, assign the characters, done. Exporting your packs is easy, including 1 click upload to the Steam Workshop, or even just export the packs directly to your PC.

PLAY IT YOUR WAY
- Local co-op: up to 8 players on one machine, bring your friends!
- Online: up to 12 players online with built-in voice chat. Share a room code and go, no port forwarding
- Party modes: You choose how you play, chat voting, player voting, pack party tournaments and many more options
- Studio mode: For when you just want to make something without the fluff.

FEATURES
- Dub over real movie scenes
- Clip Studio: turn any video into a clip pack
- Steam Workshop: browse, download and upload packs
- Convert Choicer Voicer packs
- Local co-op for up to 8 players
- Online for up to 12 players, with voice chat
- Party modes and Pack Party tournaments
- Studio mode for making videos
- Auto, player and chat-vote scoring
- Export and share your dubs
- Dark mode
- Steam achievements
- plus much more to come...

FOLLOW NIGHTCAP INTERACTIVE
Website: https://nightcapinteractive.co.uk
Discord: https://discord.gg/f6BBq9Pkfp
X: https://x.com/NightcapInt
Instagram: https://instagram.com/nightcapinteractive/
Facebook: https://facebook.com/profile.php?id=61592016382988
YouTube: https://youtube.com/@NightcapInteractive

Inspired by Choicer Voicer.
